text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I know a hero.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At times persevering with sheer will to forge a path.
Like a finely honed blade.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And at other times, she would relentlessly dig her heels in,
like an indomitable shield that refused to give up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her name is Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wrote down her wonderful story
in its entirety in this notebook.
I wrote it down, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The notebook, completely worn out over the course of three years, finally had only one page left.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how should I bring
this story to a close—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"You were selected as the Umamusume of the Year!!
Congratulations, truly and honestly,
Rob Roy-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Rob Roy-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wawa... Th-Thank you both so much!
Um, I'm sorry you had to go out of your way to talk to me...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to apologize for! If anything,
everyone's dying to talk to you—
and celebrate with you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wanna celebrate, wanna celebrate
a marvelous Rob Roy so baaaad☆★☆
Congratulations, Rob Roy!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah... Th-Thank you very much,
um...!!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. ...If you'd like, next time,
may I... treat you to a drink,
as a celebration... and a companion for your reading?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm-hmm!! And to add my own congratulations to the mix, a drop—no, three drops—of a wonderful new drug!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Stop it, moron. ...Hey, Rob Roy,
name your terms. In exchange, your data—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Kyuu...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...So, that's what happened
during lunch today..."
choice_data_list: I didn't know getting celebrated too much could make you dizzy...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! T-Trainer,
did you just laugh a little...fa!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I myself think it's quite questionable too, but... hau.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy hung her head, looking utterly dejected.
While that behavior was typical of her, still...
choice_data_list: Still, you've changed quite a bit since the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Remember when we first trained with the upperclassmen?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that did happen, didn't it...?
Surrounded by such amazing seniors, I got all fired up, but I couldn't stand out at all..."
choice_data_list: Still, today, you were the center of attention.
Still, today, you were the center of attention.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed—that's true.
...Fufufu."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though looking a little bashful,
Zenno Rob Roy smiled proudly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was some time after that
when she and I were both summoned together—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? O-Overseas, you say!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative!!
They said they absolutely wish to invite you,
the Horse Girl of the Year!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I have zero intention of forcing you!
I strongly recommend deciding based strictly on your own will
and your Trainer's input!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer...
what do... you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy asks while trying to read my expression.
Yet, deep within her downcast eyes—
choice_data_list: First, can I hear how you feel about this, Rob Roy?
First, can I ask how you're feeling, Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I want to go see it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From the very beginning, those eyes were filled with the radiant drive toward glory befitting a hero.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The two of them wait in the airport lobby for their flight to the UK.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for Zenno Rob Roy—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The UK has so many heroic tales
and fantastical folklore, you know.
Like the famous Legend of King Arthur...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: 'Rob Roy', which I mentioned before, is a Scottish tale, and there are many rich Celtic myths from that region as well—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...As for Zenno Rob Roy, she was terribly, thoroughly fidgety.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: My running... I wonder if it will hold up overseas...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I got so excited hearing about the UK
that I just rushed out here,
but maybe that was reckless of me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, with new horizons right before my eyes,
the negativity I thought I had conquered
is flooding right back……!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes...
choice_data_list: Could you ever just give up?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...That's impossible, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. As expected of you, Trainer.
Well, we have spent three years together, after all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No matter how utterly I'm beaten, time after time...
In the end, I think I'll still cling on to it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "...And there, clinging stubbornly and with endless regret to the dream of becoming a 'hero.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...'You went all the way to the world stage just for that?' ...Something like that would be way too embarrassing, right...? Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She pauses to think for a moment, then quickly shakes her head.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And my debut is delayed too...
I haven't achieved any results, and no one's paying attention to me, yet...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, I still want to cling
to the word 'hero.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she seems meek at first glance, she simply refuses to give up.
Stubborn, and clinging tenaciously—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She possesses an unbending will
that is truly that strong."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: It was that part of you I fell for in the first place.
It was that part of you I fell for in the first place, you know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, ...wha, ah, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, haha, ahahahahaha!!
Oh, Trainer, honestly...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
Fufu... Well then.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I may be an unsightly "hero"...
...but please continue to support me,
from now on as well.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's it, Trainer!
Since we have the chance, let's do it over there instead of Japan—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Why don't you buy a new notebook?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Tale of Zenno Rob Roy's Heroism"
The conclusion of Part 1, and the beginning of Part 2—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "『Triumphant songs resound. Flower petals dance in the air. Along the sparkling road to glory—』"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “—Behold, the hero marches on.”
